Knowledge of both Flutter and React Native, or experience with React and web frontends. Experience with native Android or iOS development. What Were Looking For Youre a great fit if you: Take strong ownership and see a feature through from idea to production. Care about app quality, speed, and a smooth user experience. Why Join RevRag AI Real ownership: your apps and SDKs go into production and are used by real BFSI customers. Hands-on work on in-app AI agents and Voice AI, at the frontier of how apps are built. Exposure to real-world BFSI workflows across lending, banking, insurance, and fintech. Work closely with product, design, backend, and AI engineers to ship. Opportunity to shape engineering standards for mobile and frontend as the team grows. Work directly with the founders, with a front-row seat to how an AI startup builds a product category from scratch. About RevRag AI RevRag AI is a Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup building production-grade Voice AI and LLM-powered automation for customer-facing workflows. Our multilingual, in-app AI agents plug directly into BFSI journeys, improving digital onboarding, sales, and support while cutting operational cost by up to 70%.
